definitions.explanation: A formal or medical term for a young child, typically from infancy through early childhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小児科|しょうにか}→小児科：08652_shounika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go to the pediatrics department.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小児|しょうに}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This medicine cannot be used for children.

examples.japanese: {小児|しょうに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}→予防接種：11068_yobousesshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生後|せいご}⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧か{月|げつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Children's vaccinations begin from two months after birth.

notes:
Primarily used in medical, legal, and administrative contexts. In everyday conversation, {子|こ}ども is used instead. The most commonly encountered compound is ⟦{小児科|しょうにか}→小児科：08652_shounika⟧ (pediatrics), which every parent in Japan will use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小児科|しょうにか}→小児科：08652_shounika⟧: pediatrics; children's medicine
- {小児科医|しょうにかい}: pediatrician
- {小児|しょうに}⟦{病棟|びょうとう}→病棟：21002_byoutou⟧: children's ward
- {小児|しょうに}ぜんそく: childhood asthma
- {小児|しょうに}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for children (on packaging and dosage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {子|こ}ども: child — the standard everyday word
- ⟦{幼児|ようじ}→幼児：12478_youji⟧: infant; toddler — specifically younger children, roughly ages 1-6
- ⟦{乳児|にゅうじ}→乳児：11414_nyuuji⟧: baby; infant — specifically babies under one year old
- ⟦{児童|じどう}→児童：03340_jidou⟧: schoolchild — used in educational and legal contexts for elementary-age children
